name: ByTheLaw
one_line: Chat assistant that answers legal questions with citations to official Portuguese and EU sources, analyses uploaded documents, drafts contracts, emails and translations, and organises work in projects. The site menu names it 'ByTheLaw: Legal research and knowledge'; the help centre calls it 'Legal Chat'.
note: Everything here is from public pages. Facts carry their source and the time they were read; the hypothesis and the suggestions are ours and say so. GAMMA-Ray is a beta standard: every rating is experimental.

configs.what: ByTheLaw (Legal Chat) with its documented defaults.
Citius integration: experimental, free, granted by ByTheLaw to selected users who enter their own Citius credentials; read-only access to court notifications, hearings and case movements.
Per-project source restriction: the user switches individual official sources on or off for a project.

facts.label: The person operates: every action is prompted and controlled by them
facts.fact: In the chat as shipped, the lawyer writes each request and the assistant returns an answer to it; this credit is for the chat only, since in the optional Citius configuration ByTheLaw reads Citius on its own schedule without a prompt (see not credited).
facts.quote: ByTheLaw interprets the request and returns an answer grounded in official sources.

facts.label: It connects to external tools or services across a trust boundary
facts.fact: The Citius integration uses the lawyer's own Citius credentials to read the courts system automatically, and Citius can be a source of the chat on request and approval; experimental, granted by ByTheLaw to selected users.
facts.quote: utilizar as Credenciais Citius para aceder ao Citius de forma automatizada

facts.label: A limit on it is a rule in prose
facts.fact: The Citius terms state in prose that the authorisation covers only consulting and reading.
facts.quote: A autorização prevista no número anterior é limitada às operações de

facts.label: High-impact actions need a person's approval
facts.fact: In the Citius integration, an unread notification is opened (which marks it read in Citius, irreversibly) only after the user's prior express action, preceded by a warning.
facts.quote: após ação prévia e expressa do Utilizador na Plataforma

facts.label: Its limits and known failure cases are documented for those who use it
facts.fact: Help pages document limits of use, such as upload limits and that files attached inside an email are not opened.
facts.quote: Files attached inside the email are not opened

facts.label: The data it uses is described
facts.fact: The help centre lists the legislative, case-law and regulatory databases answers are drawn from.
facts.quote: ByTheLaw draws on the legislative, case-law and regulatory databases in this list

help.label: Our hypothesis, not their claim. Built from public pages only; nothing of theirs was tested.
help.pitch: RiskMandate would measure, for one real deployment of ByTheLaw's agents, what each agent was asked to do (its mandate), what its credentials and connections actually let it reach (its grant), and the difference between the two (the gap), and keep that as a written record. It is read-only: never in the request path.

items.title: Check and claim the GAMMA-Ray card
items.text: The card is beta and read only from public pages; ByTheLaw has not reviewed it. A correction is dated and published, and a file at /.well-known/fact-ray.json on their own domain raises the trust of every fact on it.
